name: Home
description: A marker and Garden 3D under a Group root (D53) on the tulips 8x6 world with one robot. Every kit port is fed by a Variable the drive sets through Noodl.Variables; Tile X, Tile Y, Supported and Frame Ms are written back into Variables, and the Tile Tapped and Ready signals count through a Counter each into a Variable, so the drive reads the ports, not the DOM.
